title: Octopus Browser Relay System Architecture
description: Octopus Browser Relay places two protocol gateways around one long-running broker service. Every agent command enters through MCP with an opaque bindingRef, and the broker validates that reference against the authenticated agent before resolving a private extension target. The live version-two deployment currently has three exclusive bindings and three connected Chrome or AdsPower profile extensions; the broker alone owns routing truth.

blocks.text:
Trace required for every successful command:
MCP_ACCEPT(bindingRef) → BINDING_VALIDATED(principal,target) → POLICY_DECISION → COMMAND_COMMIT → WS_SEND → EXT_ACK → EXT_RESULT → MCP_OBSERVED
Dispatch returns a durable receipt; MCP_OBSERVED is the later terminal-result query. Join by runId + bindingRef + requestId + commandId and verify the resolved target against the profile fixture marker.
